g.text: View from inside looking north · west at left · loft floor is the zero datum
Seven-foot door retained under a trial 24-in trussed header. Header underside is 8 ft above floor: 12 in above nominal door top.
¹32-in door width retained from earlier drawing; actual rough opening and connection allowances are not yet specified.
Upper wall is 10 ft high in this trial; the entire wall is not a 24-in-deep truss. Side-frame webs and prior windows remain unresolved.
W4 / N1 / N2 indicate projected support axes, not approval of continuous posts through openings. T-N is below-floor framing and must clear the garage door below.
